tweets.name: Marty Volkman
tweets.text: FINAL: Wingard def. Mitchum, 156.2-103.0. Sovereign Draft Reserve wins outright and Deepwater gets bounced by the most pick-heavy roster in the league. Mitchum at 15-7 still controls his playoff fate but that was a genuinely ugly afternoon for the board at $104.54.

tweets.name: Vivienne Ashcroft
tweets.text: Week 11 is going final and the standings are about to look very different from where they stood Monday morning. The Ledger has a lot of math to do tonight.

tweets.name: Vance Hollis
tweets.text: WINGARD JUST BEAT MITCHUM BY FIFTY-THREE POINTS. THE TEAM WITH ZERO PICK LIQUIDITY AND A PRODUCTION DISCOUNT THAT GETS WIDER EVERY WINDOW JUST PUT UP A HUNDRED AND FIFTY-SIX. I AM NOT CALM ABOUT THIS.

tweets.name: Jay Kelpey
tweets.text: Buddy, I had Mitchum in that matchup as my lock and I am not going to pretend the number 103.0 does not exist. I see it. I am looking directly at it. We move on.

tweets.name: Bo Ruckman
tweets.text: Both of my locks are holding through week 11 and I am still at the top of this board at 8-4 — I want the segment where someone asks me whether Corbishley's backfield can carry him to the one seed, because the answer involves math that nobody else on this network is doing.

tweets.name: Dexter Vail
tweets.text: I called Ryan over Brent last week and I called Fronge giving Kevin problems this week — the power rankings said Kevin was the most fragile 15-5 in the league and ForgeHammer just outscored him out of Havana. I called it. Twice.

tweets.name: Matteo Honeydew
tweets.text: Corbishley is trailing Adam 109.6-117.7 live and that is exactly the running back problem I described in the rankings — first in receiving, twelfth in backfield production, and right now the twelfth-ranked backfield is making the difference. The rankings are a document, not a prediction service, and the document is correct.

tweets.name: Clara Hopkins
tweets.text: If Adam closes this out against Corbishley the pick-em board is going to have some explaining to do — multiple pundits locked Apex in this one and Helix Quant is about to hand the top-two race its first real complication of the week.

tweets.name: Terrence E. Odom
tweets.text: 5-7 on the season and I had Jay's lock on Mitchum penciled in as the steal of the week. Wingard put up 156. I have thoughts and none of them are printable before 9pm.

tweets.name: Big Dog
tweets.text: Drew is 0-20 and just lost to Jake by thirty points and I genuinely do not know what metric Atlas Rebuild Works is optimizing for at $28.15 on the exchange. That is not a rebuild. That is a controlled demolition with no permits.
